source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 10 exercise solved (PDF 246-250), MCQ keys from the chapter, numericals worked and checked against the printed answers.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 10 (Electromagnetism) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, constructed response aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) hain; har numerical step by step hal kiya gaya hai. Mushkil jagah "Wazahat" box aasan alfaaz mein samjhata hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
10.1 A current is flowing towards north along a power line. The direction of the magnetic field over the wire is directed towards:
(Bijli ki taar mein current shimal (north) ki taraf beh raha hai. Taar ke oopar magnetic field ki simt kya hogi?)
blocks.explanation: Right-hand grip rule: taar ko pakrein, angootha north (current ki simt) mein; ungliyan taar ke oopar se west ki taraf mudti hain. Is liye taar ke oopar field west ki taraf hai.

blocks.prompt:
10.2 The radius of curvature of the path of a charged particle in a uniform magnetic field is directly proportional to:
(Uniform magnetic field mein charged particle ke raste ka radius kis ke seedha mutanasib hai?)

options.text: the flux density of the field

blocks.explanation: Magnetic force centripetal force ka kaam karti hai: qvB = mv²/r, is liye r = mv/(qB) = p/(qB). r momentum ke mutanasib hai.

blocks.prompt:
10.3 The diagram shows a beam of electrons entering a magnetic field. What is the effect of magnetic field on the electrons? [Printed diagram: the beam of electrons moves to the right; the magnetic field lines are vertical, pointing down the page.]
(Diagram mein electrons ki beam magnetic field mein daakhil ho rahi hai. Field ka electrons par kya asar hai? [Beam daayein taraf, field lines neeche ki taraf.])

options.text: They are deflected into the plane of the diagram.
They are deflected out of the plane of the diagram.
They are deflected towards the bottom of the diagram.
They are deflected towards the top of the diagram.

blocks.explanation: F = qv × B. Positive charge ke liye v (daayein) × B (neeche) page ke andar hai. Electron negative hai, is liye force ulat jati hai: page se bahar. (Force v aur B dono ke perpendicular hai, is liye oopar-neeche nahi ho sakti.)

blocks.prompt:
10.4 The force exerted on a wire of 1 metre length carrying 1 ampere current placed at right angle to the magnetic field is called:
(1 m lambi, 1 A current wali taar jo magnetic field ke perpendicular ho, us par force ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: F = BIL se B = F/IL: B adadi tor par 1 m, 1 A wali perpendicular taar par force hai. B ko magnetic induction (magnetic field strength, flux density) kehte hain.

blocks.prompt:
10.5 The unit of flux density is:
(Flux density ka unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: B = F/IL, is liye 1 T = 1 N A⁻¹ m⁻¹ (= 1 Wb m⁻²).

blocks.prompt:
10.6 A moving charged particle is surrounded by:
(Harkat karta charged particle kis se ghira hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har charge ka electric field hota hai; harkat karta charge current bhi hai, is liye magnetic field bhi banata hai.

blocks.prompt:
10.7 Magnetic force on the charge q moving parallel to magnetic field with velocity v is:
(Magnetic field ke parallel v se chalte charge q par magnetic force kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: F = qvB sinθ; field ke parallel θ = 0°, sin 0° = 0, is liye F = 0.

blocks.prompt:
10.8 The unit N A⁻¹ m⁻¹ is called:
(Unit N A⁻¹ m⁻¹ ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: 1 tesla = 1 N A⁻¹ m⁻¹, magnetic induction B ka unit. (Weber, N m A⁻¹, flux ka unit hai.)

blocks.prompt:
10.9 Electrons while moving perpendicularly through a uniform magnetic field are:
(Uniform magnetic field mein perpendicular chalte electrons:)
blocks.explanation: Force qvB hamesha velocity ke perpendicular hai, is liye centripetal force ban kar electrons ko daire (circle) mein ghumati hai (r = mv/eB).

blocks.prompt:
10.10 A magnet is suspended from a spring. The magnet oscillates and moves in and out of the coil connected to a galvanometer. When the magnet oscillates, the galvanometer shows:
(Spring se latka magnet coil ke andar bahar jhoolta hai; coil galvanometer se juri hai. Galvanometer kya dikhayega?)

options.text: deflection to the left and to the right with constant amplitude
deflection to the left and right, but the amplitude steadily decreases

blocks.explanation: Andar aur bahar jane se flux ulti simt mein badalta hai, is liye induced current ulat'ta hai (daayein-baayein deflection). Lenz's law ke mutabiq induced current harkat ki mukhalifat karta hai aur jhoolne ki energy leta hai, is liye amplitude dheere dheere kam hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
10.1 It is said that Lenz's law specifically applies to induced currents and not directly to induce emf. Explain it briefly.
(Kaha jata hai ke Lenz's law khaas tor par induced current par lagta hai, induced emf par seedha nahi. Mukhtasar wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Lenz's law kehta hai ke induced current us tabdeeli ki mukhalifat karta hai jis se woh bana; yeh mukhalifat current ke magnetic field (ya force) se hoti hai. Khule circuit mein emf koi current nahi chalata, is liye koi mukhalifat nahi. Is liye Lenz's law band loop par lagaya jata hai (ya loop ko band farz kiya jata hai), current ki simt nikal kar us se emf ki polarity maloom ki jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
10.2 A square loop of wire is moving through a uniform magnetic field. The normal to the loop is oriented parallel to the magnetic field. Is an emf induced in the loop? Give a reason for your answer.
(Taar ka square loop uniform magnetic field mein chal raha hai aur us ka normal field ke parallel hai. Kya loop mein emf induce hoga? Wajah dein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Loop mein flux φ = BA cos 0° = BA. Uniform field mein chalte hue (bina ghoome ya field se nikle) B, A aur zawiya wohi rehte hain, flux nahi badalta, is liye emf induce nahi hota.

blocks.prompt:
10.3 Does the induced emf always act to decrease the magnetic flux through a circuit?
(Kya induced emf hamesha circuit mein magnetic flux ko kam karne ki koshish karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Induced emf (current) flux ki tabdeeli ki mukhalifat karta hai, khud flux ki nahi. Flux barh raha ho to use kam karne ki koshish, aur kam ho raha ho to use barhane (qaim rakhne) ki koshish karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
10.4 When a magnet is pushed into the solenoid, as shown in the figure (a), the galvanometer indicates a small current. Why is the current produced? What will be the magnetic pole produced at the left end of the solenoid? [Figure (a): a bar magnet hangs from a spring with its N pole up and its S pole entering the end of the coil, which is joined to a galvanometer.]
(Magnet ko solenoid mein dhakelne par galvanometer chhota current dikhata hai. Current kyun banta hai? Solenoid ke us sire par kaun sa pole banega?)
blocks.explanation:
Magnet andar dhakelne se solenoid mein magnetic flux barhta hai. Faraday's law ke mutabiq badalta flux emf induce karta hai jo band circuit mein current chalata hai.
Lenz's law ke mutabiq magnet ki taraf wala sira aane wale pole ko dhakelta hai. Magnet ka S pole andar aa raha hai, is liye woh sira (jise kitab left end kehti hai) south pole banta hai.

blocks.prompt:
10.5 A bar magnet falls through a fixed metal ring (Fig b). Will the magnet fall with an acceleration of a freely falling body? Give reason.
(Bar magnet aik fixed metal ring mein se girta hai. Kya woh azadana girne wali cheez (g) ke acceleration se girega? Wajah dein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi, acceleration g se kam hoga. Girte magnet se ring mein flux badalta hai aur current induce hota hai. Lenz's law ke mutabiq yeh current harkat ki mukhalifat karta hai (aate hue dhakelta, jaate hue kheenchta hai), is liye magnet par oopar ki force lagti hai.

blocks.prompt:
10.6 Which of the two charged particles of the same mass will be deflected most in the magnetic field (a) fast moving (b) slow moving?
(Barabar mass wale do charged particles mein se kaun magnetic field mein zyada mudega: (a) tez (b) aahista?)
blocks.explanation: (b) Aahista wala (charge barabar maan kar). Daire ka radius r = mv/(qB); kam v se radius chhota, yani raasta zyada mura hua, is liye zyada deflection.

blocks.prompt:
10.7 An electron and a proton are projected into a magnetic field at right angles to it with a certain velocity. Which of the particles will suffer greater deflection? Why?
(Electron aur proton aik hi velocity se magnetic field mein perpendicular phenke gaye. Kis ka deflection zyada hoga? Kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Electron. Dono ka charge e barabar aur v barabar hai, is liye r = mv/(eB) ∝ m. Electron ka mass proton ka taqreeban 1/1836 hai, is liye us ka radius bohat chhota aur deflection zyada hota hai (aur ulti simt mein).

blocks.prompt:
10.8 Can a single moving proton produce magnetic field?
(Kya aik akela harkat karta proton magnetic field bana sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Haan. Harkat karta charge electric current hai, aur har current apne gird magnetic field banata hai. Is liye chalta proton electric aur magnetic dono fields se ghira hota hai (ruka hua proton sirf electric field rakhta hai).

blocks.prompt:
10.9 A magnetic field is necessary if there is to be a magnetic flux passing through a coil of wire. Yet, just because there is a magnetic field does not mean that a magnetic flux will pass through a coil. Account for this situation.
(Coil mein flux ke liye magnetic field zaroori hai, magar field hone se flux lazmi nahi guzarta. Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Flux φ = BA cos θ, jahan θ, B aur coil ke normal ka zawiya hai. Agar coil ka plane field ke parallel ho (θ = 90°) to cos 90° = 0, field mojood hone ke bawajood flux sifar hai. Flux B ke ilawa rukh (orientation) aur area par bhi munhasir hai.

blocks.prompt:
10.1 A charge is lying stationary between the opposite poles of two magnets. Is a magnetic force exerted on it? Why?
(Aik charge do magnets ke mukhalif poles ke darmiyan ruka para hai. Kya us par magnetic force lagti hai? Kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Charge par magnetic force F = qvB sin θ. Ruke hue charge ke liye v = 0, is liye F = 0. Magnetic field sirf harkat karte charge par force lagata hai.

blocks.prompt:
10.2 When the switch in the circuit is closed, a current is established in the coil and the metal ring jumps upward. Why? Describe what would happen to the ring if the battery polarity were reversed. [Figure: a metal ring rests on top of a vertical coil wound on an iron core; the coil is connected to a battery through switch S.]
(Switch band karne par coil mein current aata hai aur metal ring oopar uchhalti hai. Kyun? Battery ki polarity ulat di jaye to ring ka kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation:
Switch band karte hi coil ka current sifar se barhta hai, is liye ring mein flux achanak barhta hai. Faraday's law se ring mein emf aur current induce hota hai. Lenz's law se ring ka current flux ke barhne ki mukhalifat karta hai, yani coil ke current ke ulat behta hai; ring aik magnet ban jati hai jis ka milta julta pole coil ki taraf hota hai, is liye coil use dhakelti hai aur ring oopar uchhalti hai.
Polarity ulat dein to bhi ring oopar uchhalti hai: coil ka field ulat jata hai magar ring mein flux phir bhi sifar se barhta hai, is liye induced current phir coil ke current ke ulat hota hai. Ulte currents har haal mein aik doosre ko dhakelte hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Ring ko aise samjhein: coil achanak magnet banti hai, ring kehti hai "mujhe yeh tabdeeli manzoor nahi" aur ulta magnet ban kar door bhaagti hai. Battery ulti karne se dono magnets ulte ho jate hain magar phir bhi aamne saamne milte julte poles hote hain, is liye dhakka wohi rehta hai.

blocks.prompt:
10.3 The figure shows a coil of wire in the x – y plane with a magnetic field directed along the y-axis. Around which of the three-coordinate axis should the coil be rotated in order to generate an emf and a current in the coil?
(Figure mein taar ki coil x – y plane mein hai aur magnetic field y-axis ke saath hai. Coil ko kis axis ke gird ghumayein ke emf aur current paida ho?)
blocks.explanation:
x-axis ke gird.
Coil x–y plane mein hai, us ka normal z-axis ke saath, B (y ke saath) ke perpendicular: shuru mein flux sifar hai.
- x-axis ke gird ghumane se normal y-axis ki taraf jhukta hai, B aur normal ka zawiya badalta hai, flux badalta hai aur emf aur current induce hote hain.
- y-axis ke gird ghumane se normal x–z plane mein rehta hai, hamesha B ke perpendicular, flux sifar hi rehta hai.
- z-axis ke gird ghumane se coil x–y plane mein hi rehti hai, flux sifar rehta hai.

blocks.prompt:
10.4 Is it possible to change both the area of the loop and the magnetic field passing through the loop and still not have an induced emf in the loop? Give reason.
(Kya loop ka area aur magnetic field dono badal kar bhi loop mein emf induce na ho, yeh mumkin hai? Wajah dein.)
blocks.explanation: Haan. Emf sirf tab induce hota hai jab flux φ = BA cos θ badle. Agar B aur A aise badlein ke un ka hasil-e-zarb (product) wohi rahe (maslan area dugna aur saath hi B aadha), to flux nahi badalta aur emf induce nahi hota.

blocks.prompt:
10.5 Does the application of uniform magnetic field to a moving charged particle result in a change in kinetic energy of the particle? Explain.
(Kya uniform magnetic field harkat karte charged particle ki kinetic energy badal deta hai? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Magnetic force F = q(v × B) hamesha velocity ke perpendicular hai, is liye koi kaam nahi karti (W = Fd cos 90° = 0). Yeh sirf simt badalti hai, raftaar nahi, is liye kinetic energy ½mv² wohi rehti hai.

blocks.prompt:
10.6 A uniform electric field and a magnetic field act in the same direction. A proton is projected, into the space, with a uniform velocity in opposite direction. What will happen to the proton?
(Uniform electric aur magnetic field aik hi simt mein hain. Proton un ki ulti simt mein phenka jata hai. Proton ka kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation:
Magnetic force: velocity B ke ulat (θ = 180°), is liye F = qvB sin 180° = 0; magnetic field ka koi asar nahi.
Electric force: F = qE proton par E ki simt mein, yani us ki velocity ke ulat. Is liye proton seedhi line mein aahista hota hai, lamhe bhar ruk kar wapas E ki simt mein tez hota hai. Woh side par nahi mudta.

blocks.prompt:
10.7 A conductor moves in a magnetic field when a current is passed through the conductor. Would you expect the reverse effect to occur? That is, would a current be produced if a conductor is moved across the magnetic field?
(Current wala conductor magnetic field mein harkat karta hai. Kya ulta asar bhi hota hai, yani field mein conductor chalane se current paida hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Haan. Conductor ko magnetic field mein chalane se us ke siron par motional emf ε = vBL induce hota hai (electromagnetic induction). Band circuit ho to yeh emf current chalata hai. Yahi generator ka usool hai, jo motor ke asar ka ulat hai.

blocks.prompt:
10.8 Consider a conducting rod of length L moving with velocity v to the right as shown in the figure. Left ends of the conducting rails are connected to a bulb. Due to motion of the rod through the magnetic field, an emf is produced across the ends of the rod. This emf gives rise to a current I. As a result, the bulb lights up. Explain where does the electrical energy consumed by the bulb come from? [Figure: the magnetic field B is into the page; the rod slides to the right on two rails a distance d apart.]
(Rod L velocity v se daayein chal rahi hai; rails ke baayein sire bulb se jure hain. Emf aur current I se bulb jalta hai. Bulb ki bijli ki energy kahan se aati hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Bahar se rod ko kheenchne wale ke kaam se.
Rod mein induced current I magnetic field mein behta hai, is liye rod par magnetic force F = ILB lagti hai. Lenz's law ke mutabiq yeh force velocity ke ulat hai aur rod ko rokti hai. Rod ko yaksaan velocity se chalane ke liye harkat ki simt mein ILB ke barabar bahar ki force lagani parti hai. Is force ka mechanical kaam electrical energy ban jata hai (P = Fv = ILBv = Iε), jise bulb roshni aur heat mein badalta hai. Yeh energy ke conservation ke mutabiq hai.

blocks.prompt:
10.9 What will you do if you want to save a sensitive instrument from stray magnetic fields?
(Kisi hassas aale ko bhatakte (stray) magnetic fields se kaise bachayenge?)
blocks.explanation: Aale ko soft iron (ya mu-metal jaise zyada permeability wale material) ke dabbe mein band karein. Magnetic field lines iron ki deewaron mein se guzar kar andar ki jagah ke gird ghoom jati hain, is liye dabbe ke andar taqreeban koi magnetic field nahi rehta (magnetic shielding).

blocks.prompt:
10.1 Distinguish between magnetic flux and flux density. How are they related?
(Magnetic flux aur flux density mein farq bataein. In ka aapas mein talluq kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Magnetic flux kisi area mein se guzarne wali field lines ki tadaad hai; flux density field ke perpendicular unit area mein flux hai. Talluq: φ = B·A = BA cos θ, aur perpendicular area ke liye B = φ/A.

rows: Diye gaye area mein se guzarne wali magnetic field lines ki tadaad
Field ke perpendicular unit area mein field lines ki tadaad
B = φ/A (area field ke perpendicular); B = F/IL
Vector miqdaar, field ki simt mein
Unit: tesla (T) = Wb m⁻² = N A⁻¹ m⁻¹
B, area aur us ke rukh par munhasir
Kisi point par field ki taqat batata hai

blocks.prompt:
10.2 Find an expression for the force exerted on a current-carrying conductor placed in a uniform magnetic field.
(Uniform magnetic field mein rakhe current wale conductor par force ka formula hasil karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Jab current wala conductor magnetic field mein rakha jaye to us ka apna field bahar ke field se milta hai: aik taraf dono field mil kar mazboot, doosri taraf aik doosre ko kaat dete hain, aur conductor kamzor field ki taraf dhakela jata hai.
Tajurbe se, uniform field ke perpendicular seedhe conductor par force F:
1. current I ke mutanasib: F ∝ I
2. field mein conductor ki lambai L ke mutanasib: F ∝ L
3. magnetic field strength B ke mutanasib: F ∝ B
Milane se: F ∝ BIL, yani F = kBIL. SI units mein k = 1, is liye
F = BIL (conductor B ke perpendicular)
Is se B = F/IL bhi define hota hai, unit tesla, 1 T = 1 N A⁻¹ m⁻¹.
Agar conductor B se θ zawiya banaye to sirf B ke perpendicular hissa L sin θ kaam karta hai:
F = BIL sin θ
Vector shakal (L current ki simt mein): F = I L × B
Khaas suraten: θ = 90° par F zyada se zyada BIL; field ke saath (θ = 0°) F = 0.
Simt: F, L aur B dono ke perpendicular; Fleming's left-hand rule (pehli ungli field, doosri ungli current, angootha force) ya right-hand rule (ungliyan I se B ki taraf mor'ein, angootha F) se.

blocks.prompt:
10.3 State and explain Faraday's law and Lenz's law. Also describe factors affecting the induced emf.
(Faraday's law aur Lenz's law bayan karein aur wazahat karein. Induced emf par asar karne wale awamil (factors) bhi bataein.)
blocks.explanation:
Faraday ka electromagnetic induction ka qanoon:
N loops wali coil mein induced ausat emf, coil mein magnetic flux ki waqt ke saath tabdeeli ki sharah (rate) ke manfi ke barabar hai:
ε = −N Δφ/Δt
Wazahat: L lambi rod do rails par v velocity se field B (page ke andar) mein chalti hai aur band loop banti hai. Motional emf ε = −vBL. Waqt Δt mein rod Δx = vΔt chalti hai, loop ka area ΔA = LΔx aur flux Δφ = BLΔx barhta hai. Is liye ε = −BLΔx/Δt = −Δφ/Δt (aik loop), aur N loops ke liye ε = −NΔφ/Δt. Yeh nateeja flux ki har tabdeeli par lagta hai.

Lenz's law:
Induced current ki simt hamesha aisi hoti hai ke woh us tabdeeli ki mukhalifat kare jis ne use paida kiya. (Faraday's law ka manfi nishan yahi batata hai.)
Wazahat: bar magnet ka N pole coil ki taraf dhakelein to induced current coil ke saamne wale face ko north pole bana deta hai jo magnet ko dhakelta hai (magnet ki taraf se dekhein to current anticlockwise). Magnet door khenchein to woh face south pole ban kar use kheenchta hai.
Lenz's law aur energy ka conservation: chalti rod mein induced current se force F = ILB velocity ke ulat lagti hai, is liye rod ko chalane ke liye kaam karna parta hai jo bijli ki energy banta hai. Agar current ulta hota to force rod ko aur tez karti aur energy bina wajah paida hoti, jo na-mumkin hai. Is liye Lenz's law energy ke conservation ka nateeja hai.

Induced emf ke awamil (factors):
1. Magnetic flux ki tabdeeli ki sharah: flux jitna tez badle, emf utna zyada.
2. Coil ke turns ki tadaad: emf ∝ N; zyada turns, zyada emf.
3. Coil (ya conductor) aur field ki nisbati (relative) raftaar: tez raftaar se flux tez badalta hai aur emf barhta hai.
(Field ki taqat aur coil ka area bhi asar karte hain kyunke yeh flux ki tabdeeli ki miqdaar tay karte hain.)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Lenz's law ko "ziddi coil" samjhein: magnet paas laao to coil dhakelti hai, door le jao to kheenchti hai. Har dafa coil tabdeeli ke khilaf hoti hai; isi liye magnet ko hilane ke liye kaam karna parta hai aur wahi kaam bijli banta hai.

blocks.prompt:
10.4 Determine the force acting on a charged particle moving through a uniform magnetic field.
(Uniform magnetic field mein chalte charged particle par force maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Current charges ka bahao hai, is liye magnetic field mein har chalta charge force mehsoos karta hai. Current wale conductor par force se shuru karein.
1. N particles, har aik ka charge q, L lambe conductor mein se waqt t mein guzrein. Current I = Nq/t.
2. Agar un ki velocity v conductor ke saath ho to t = L/v, is liye I = Nqv/L ... (1)
3. Uniform field B mein conductor par force: F = I L × B, jahan L = L L̂ (L̂ current ki simt ka unit vector).
4. (1) rakhein: F = (Nqv/L)(L L̂ × B) = Nqv L̂ × B
5. Velocity conductor ke saath hai, v = v L̂, is liye F = Nq v × B
6. Yeh N particles par force hai, is liye aik particle par
F = q v × B
Miqdaar: F = qvB sin θ, θ = v aur B ka zawiya.
- v, B ke perpendicular (θ = 90°) ho to zyada se zyada force qvB.
- v, B ke saath (θ = 0° ya 180°) ho to force sifar, aur ruke charge par bhi sifar.
Simt: v aur B dono ke perpendicular (right-hand rule ya Fleming's left-hand rule); negative charge ke liye ulat. Page ke andar wale field mein positive charge aik taraf (maslan oopar) aur negative charge doosri taraf mur kar chalta hai. F hamesha v ke perpendicular hai, is liye sirf simt badalti hai, raftaar nahi.

blocks.prompt:
10.5 What is a velocity selector? Explain its working.
(Velocity selector kya hai? Is ka kaam samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Velocity selector: aisa aala jis mein chalte charged particle par electric aur magnetic forces is tarah lagti hain ke sirf aik velocity par barabar ho kar aik doosre ko khatam karti hain, is liye sirf usi velocity wale particles seedhe guzarte hain.
Banawat: uniform magnetic field B (page ke andar) mein rakhi aik nalki (tube). Tube ke andar parallel plate capacitor uniform electric field E banata hai jo B ke perpendicular hai. Particle E aur B dono ke perpendicular velocity v se daakhil hota hai.
Kaam: positive charge +q ke liye:
- magnetic force F_B = qvB, oopar ki taraf;
- electric force F_E = qE, neeche (E ki simt).
E aur B ko aisa rakha jata hai ke dono forces barabar ho kar khatam ho jayein. Net force sifar ho to particle seedhi line mein yaksaan velocity se chalta hai (Newton ka pehla qanoon) aur tube ke daayein sire se nikal jata hai.
Shart: qvB = qE, is liye
v = E/B
E/B se tez particles par magnetic force zyada, woh aik taraf mur jate hain; aahista particles doosri taraf; is liye woh bahar nahi nikalte. Yun sirf v = E/B wale particles chune jate hain, charge ya mass kuch bhi ho.

blocks.prompt:
10.6 Explain how ferrofluids work?
(Ferrofluids kaise kaam karte hain? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ferrofluid: aisa material jo liquid aur magnet dono ki khoobiyan rakhta hai.
Banawat: magnetic nano particles (aam tor par iron oxide, taqreeban 10 nm) ka carrier fluid (tail ya paani) mein colloidal suspension. Particles par surfactant ki teh hoti hai jo surface tension kam karti aur unhein aapas mein chipakne se rokti hai, taake woh yaksaan phaile rahein. Fluid ki viscosity (gaarha pan), particles ka nanha size aur un ki musalsal harkat unhein neeche baithne nahi deti.
Kaam:
1. Magnet paas na ho to ferrofluid aam liquid ki tarah behta hai.
2. Magnet paas laayein to particles waqti tor par magnetized ho jate hain aur fluid khud magnet ban jata hai; particles field lines ke saath zanjeer (chain) jaisi shakal banate hain jo viscosity barhati hai, aur fluid solid jaisa ban jata hai.
3. Shakal magnetic forces, surface tension aur gravity ke muqable se banti hai. Jahan magnetic force ghalib ho wahan fluid field lines ke saath nokeele spikes bana leta hai.
4. Magnet hatane par particles demagnetize ho jate hain aur fluid phir aam liquid ban jata hai.
Tajurba: laser printer ka toner (taqreeban 40% iron oxide nano particles) cooking oil mein mila kar botal mein dalein; magnet paas laayein to fluid us ki taraf uchhalta aur spikes banata hai.
Istemal: computer hard drives aur motors ki rotary seals; loudspeaker ki voice coil ko thanda rakhna aur vibration kam karna; bahar ke magnets se dawa ko khaas jagah pohanchana; MRI mein contrast agent; liquid ke bahao ko control karna.

blocks.prompt:
10.1 A positively charged particle is projected perpendicularly into a magnetic field at a speed of 1500 m s⁻¹. It experiences a force of magnitude F. At what angle θ with the field, the particle should be projected at a speed of 2000 m s⁻¹, so that it experiences the same magnitude of force? (Ans: θ = 49°)
(Positive charged particle 1500 m s⁻¹ se field ke perpendicular phenka jata hai aur force F mehsoos karta hai. 2000 m s⁻¹ par field se kis zawiye θ par phenkein ke force wohi rahe?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): v₁ = 1500 m s⁻¹ at θ₁ = 90°; v₂ = 2000 m s⁻¹; same F, same q and B
Maloom karna hai (Required): θ = ?
Hal (Solution):
F = qvB sin θ
qv₁B sin 90° = qv₂B sin θ
sin θ = v₁/v₂ = 1500/2000 = 0.75
θ = sin⁻¹(0.75) = 48.6° ≈ 49°
Jawab (Answer): θ ≈ 49°

blocks.prompt:
10.2 Electrons are accelerated from rest through a potential difference of 15 kV in an oscilloscope. The electrons then pass through a 0.35 T magnetic field that deflects them to the desired position on the screen. Find the magnitude of the maximum force that an electron can experience. (Ans: 4.1 × 10⁻¹² N)
(Oscilloscope mein electrons 15 kV potential difference se aaram ki halat se tez kiye jate hain, phir 0.35 T field se guzarte hain. Electron par zyada se zyada force kitni ho sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): V = 15 kV = 1.5 × 10⁴ V; B = 0.35 T; e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C; m = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg
Maloom karna hai (Required): F_max = ?
Hal (Solution):
Haasil shuda raftaar: ½mv² = eV
v = √(2eV/m) = √(2 × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ × 1.5 × 10⁴/9.1 × 10⁻³¹) = √(5.27 × 10¹⁵) = 7.26 × 10⁷ m s⁻¹
Force zyada se zyada tab hai jab v, B ke perpendicular ho (sin 90° = 1):
F_max = evB = (1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C)(7.26 × 10⁷ m s⁻¹)(0.35 T) = 4.07 × 10⁻¹² N
Jawab (Answer): F_max ≈ 4.1 × 10⁻¹² N

blocks.prompt:
10.3 A square coil of side 15 cm each consists of 60 turns. Initially, it is located in a uniform magnetic field of magnitude 0.8 T such that plane of the coil is perpendicular to the field. The coil is then turned through an angle of θ = 30° in a time of 2 s. Determine the average induced emf. (Ans: 0.54 V)
(15 cm side wali square coil ke 60 turns hain. Shuru mein coil ka plane 0.8 T field ke perpendicular hai. Phir coil 2 s mein 30° ghumayi jati hai. Ausat induced emf maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): side = 15 cm = 0.15 m, A = (0.15 m)² = 0.0225 m²; N = 60; B = 0.8 T; turned through 30° in Δt = 2 s
Maloom karna hai (Required): average emf ε = ?
Hal (Solution):
Plane B ke perpendicular yani normal B ke saath: θ₁ = 0°. Ghumane ke baad θ₂ = 30°.
φ₁ = BA cos 0° = 0.8 × 0.0225 = 0.0180 Wb
φ₂ = BA cos 30° = 0.0180 × 0.866 = 0.0156 Wb
Δφ = φ₂ − φ₁ = −0.0024 Wb
ε = −N Δφ/Δt = −60 × (−0.0024 Wb)/2 s = 0.072 V
Jawab (Answer): ε ≈ 0.072 V (7.2 × 10⁻² V)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab 0.54 V chhapti hai. Yeh N × BA/Δt = 60 × 0.018/2 hai, yani tab ka emf jab saara flux khatam ho jaye (90° ghumana). 30° ghumane par flux sirf BA se BA cos 30° tak kam hota hai, is liye ausat emf 60 × 0.018 × (1 − cos 30°)/2 ≈ 0.072 V hai.

blocks.prompt:
10.4 A metallic rod is moving through a uniform magnetic field of 0.2 T. The emf induced across its ends is found to be 0.8 V. It is required to induce an emf of 2.4 V across its ends. How much field strength is needed for this? (0.6 T)
(Dhaat ki rod 0.2 T field mein chal rahi hai aur us par 0.8 V emf hai. 2.4 V emf ke liye kitna field chahiye?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): B₁ = 0.2 T, ε₁ = 0.8 V; ε₂ = 2.4 V; same v and L
Maloom karna hai (Required): B₂ = ?
Hal (Solution):
ε = vBL, so ε ∝ B (v and L unchanged)
B₂ = B₁ × ε₂/ε₁ = 0.2 T × 2.4 V/0.8 V = 0.6 T
Jawab (Answer): B₂ = 0.6 T

blocks.prompt:
10.5 A copper ring has a radius of 4.0 cm and resistance of 1.0 mΩ. A magnetic field is applied over the ring, perpendicular to its plane. If the magnetic field increases from 0.2 T to 0.4 T in a time interval of 5 × 10⁻³ s, what is the current in the ring during this interval? (Ans: 201 A)
(Copper ring ka radius 4.0 cm aur resistance 1.0 mΩ hai. Plane ke perpendicular field 5 × 10⁻³ s mein 0.2 T se 0.4 T ho jata hai. Ring mein current kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): r = 4.0 cm = 0.040 m; R = 1.0 mΩ = 1.0 × 10⁻³ Ω; ΔB = 0.4 T − 0.2 T = 0.2 T; Δt = 5 × 10⁻³ s; N = 1
Maloom karna hai (Required): I = ?
Hal (Solution):
A = πr² = 3.1416 × (0.040 m)² = 5.03 × 10⁻³ m²
ε = A ΔB/Δt = (5.03 × 10⁻³ m²)(0.2 T)/(5 × 10⁻³ s) = 0.201 V
I = ε/R = 0.201 V/(1.0 × 10⁻³ Ω) = 201 A
Jawab (Answer): I = 201 A

blocks.prompt:
10.6 A coil of 10 turns and 35 cm² area is in a perpendicular magnetic field of 0.5 T. The coil is pulled out of the field in 1.0 s. Find the induced emf in the coil as it is pulled out of the field. (Ans: 1.75 × 10⁻² V)
(10 turns aur 35 cm² area wali coil 0.5 T perpendicular field mein hai. Coil ko 1.0 s mein field se bahar khencha jata hai. Induced emf maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): N = 10; A = 35 cm² = 35 × 10⁻⁴ m²; B = 0.5 T; Δt = 1.0 s
Maloom karna hai (Required): ε = ?
Hal (Solution):
φ₁ = BA = 0.5 T × 35 × 10⁻⁴ m² = 1.75 × 10⁻³ Wb; φ₂ = 0 (out of the field)
Δφ = −1.75 × 10⁻³ Wb
ε = −N Δφ/Δt = −10 × (−1.75 × 10⁻³ Wb)/1.0 s = 1.75 × 10⁻² V
Jawab (Answer): ε = 1.75 × 10⁻² V

blocks.prompt:
10.7 A proton is accelerated by a potential difference of 6 × 10⁵ volts. It then enters perpendicularly in a uniform magnetic field B = 1.0 weber m⁻². Find the radius of curvature of the path of the proton. m = 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C. (Ans: 11.16 cm)
(Proton 6 × 10⁵ V se tez kiya jata hai, phir B = 1.0 Wb m⁻² field mein perpendicular daakhil hota hai. Raste ka radius maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): V = 6 × 10⁵ V; B = 1.0 T; m = 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg; e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C
Maloom karna hai (Required): r = ?
Hal (Solution):
Raftaar: ½mv² = eV
v = √(2eV/m) = √(2 × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ × 6 × 10⁵/1.67 × 10⁻²⁷) = √(1.15 × 10¹⁴) = 1.07 × 10⁷ m s⁻¹
Radius: evB = mv²/r, is liye
r = mv/(eB) = (1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg)(1.07 × 10⁷ m s⁻¹)/(1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C × 1.0 T) = 0.112 m
Jawab (Answer): r ≈ 0.112 m ≈ 11.2 cm (kitab ka 11.16 cm sirf rounding ka farq hai)

blocks.prompt:
10.8 A proton enters a uniform magnetic field B = 0.300 weber m⁻² in a direction making an angle 45° with the magnetic field. What will be the radius of the circular path if the velocity of proton is 10⁷ m s⁻¹. (Ans: 2.46 × 10⁻¹ m)
(Proton B = 0.300 Wb m⁻² field mein field se 45° ke zawiye par daakhil hota hai. Velocity 10⁷ m s⁻¹ ho to daire ka radius kitna hoga?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): B = 0.300 T; θ = 45°; v = 10⁷ m s⁻¹; m = 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg; e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C
Maloom karna hai (Required): r = ?
Hal (Solution):
Sirf B ke perpendicular velocity ka hissa daira banata hai: v⊥ = v sin 45°.
v⊥ = 10⁷ × 0.707 = 7.07 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹
r = m v⊥/(eB) = (1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg)(7.07 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹)/(1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C × 0.300 T) = 0.246 m
Jawab (Answer): r = 0.246 m = 2.46 × 10⁻¹ m

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: 45° par proton daire ke saath saath field ki simt mein bhi chalta hai (v cos 45° wala hissa), is liye asal raasta spring jaisa (helix) hai; sawal sirf us ke daire ka radius poochta hai.

blocks.prompt:
10.9 Three identical conducting rods L₁, L₂ and L₃ are moving in different planes with the same speeds v₁ = v₂ = v₃ = 2.5 m s⁻¹ as shown in the figure. The length of each rod is 60 cm. A constant magnetic field of magnitude B = 0.5 T is directed along z-axis. Find the magnitude of emf induced in each rod and indicate which end of the rod is positive. [(Rod L₁) emf = 0.75 V, and end a, (Rod L₂) emf = 0 (Rod L₃) emf = 0)]. [Figure: B along +z. Rod L₁ lies along the x-axis (end a towards the origin, end b towards +x) and moves along +y with v₁. Rod L₂ lies along the x-axis and moves along +z with v₂. Rod L₃ lies along the y-axis (end a towards the origin, end b towards +y) and moves along +z with v₃.]
(Teen yaksaan rods L₁, L₂, L₃ mukhtalif planes mein 2.5 m s⁻¹ se chal rahi hain; har rod 60 cm lambi hai; B = 0.5 T z-axis ke saath. Har rod ka emf aur positive sira bataein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): v = 2.5 m s⁻¹; L = 60 cm = 0.60 m; B = 0.5 T along +z
Maloom karna hai (Required): Har rod ka emf aur positive sira
Hal (Solution):
Rod L₁: v (y ke saath), B (z ke saath) aur rod (x ke saath) teeno aapas mein perpendicular:
ε₁ = vBL = 2.5 m s⁻¹ × 0.5 T × 0.60 m = 0.75 V
Positive charges par force F = q v × B: ŷ × ẑ = x̂, yani +x ki taraf, sira b ki taraf. Sira b positive (a negative).
Rod L₂: v z ke saath, B ke parallel, is liye v × B = 0: ε₂ = vBL sin 0° = 0.
Rod L₃: v bhi z ke saath, B ke parallel: ε₃ = 0.
Jawab (Answer): L₁: 0.75 V (F = q v × B se positive sira b); L₂: 0; L₃: 0

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab rod L₁ ka sira a positive batati hai. v₁ (+y) aur B (+z) se positive charges par force q v × B, +x ki taraf, yani figure ke sira b ki taraf hai; is liye b positive hai aur electrons a par jama ho kar use negative banate hain. Miqdaarein (0.75 V, 0, 0) sahi hain.

blocks.prompt:
10.10 An emf of 0.5 V is induced across the ends of a metal rod moving through a magnetic field of 0.4 T. If an emf of 1.5 V has to be induced, what field strength would be needed for that? Assume that all other factors remain the same. (Ans: 1.2 T)
(0.4 T field mein chalti rod par 0.5 V emf hai. 1.5 V ke liye kitna field chahiye, baaqi sab wohi rahe?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): ε₁ = 0.5 V at B₁ = 0.4 T; ε₂ = 1.5 V
Maloom karna hai (Required): B₂ = ?
Hal (Solution):
ε = vBL, so ε ∝ B
B₂ = B₁ × ε₂/ε₁ = 0.4 T × 1.5 V/0.5 V = 1.2 T
Jawab (Answer): B₂ = 1.2 T

blocks.prompt:
7.11 A charged particle moves through a velocity selector at a constant velocity of 4.96 × 10⁴ m s⁻¹ in a direction perpendicular to both E and B. If the magnetic field strength is 0.114 T, what should be the magnitude of electric field intensity so that the particle moves undeflected? (Ans: 5.65 × 10³ N C⁻¹)
(Charged particle velocity selector mein E aur B dono ke perpendicular 4.96 × 10⁴ m s⁻¹ ki yaksaan velocity se chalta hai. B = 0.114 T ho to E kitna ho ke particle seedha chale?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): v = 4.96 × 10⁴ m s⁻¹; B = 0.114 T
Maloom karna hai (Required): E = ?
Hal (Solution):
Bina deflection ke qE = qvB, is liye
E = vB = (4.96 × 10⁴ m s⁻¹)(0.114 T) = 5.65 × 10³ N C⁻¹
Jawab (Answer): E = 5.65 × 10³ N C⁻¹

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Aakhri do sawal 7.11 aur 7.12 chhape hain; is chapter mein yeh 10.11 aur 10.12 hain. 7.11 mein "4.96 10⁴" mein × ka nishan reh gaya hai; yeh 4.96 × 10⁴ m s⁻¹ hai.

blocks.prompt:
7.12 A current-carrying conductor PQ of length 2 m is placed perpendicularly to a magnetic field of flux density 0.5 T as shown in the figure. The resulting force on the conductor is 1 N acting into the plane of the paper. What is the magnitude and direction of the current? (Ans: 1 A, Q to P) [Figure: the field B points to the right across the page; the conductor PQ is vertical, with P at the top and Q at the bottom.]
(2 m lamba current wala conductor PQ 0.5 T field ke perpendicular hai. Us par 1 N force page ke andar lagti hai. Current ki miqdaar aur simt kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): L = 2 m; B = 0.5 T (to the right); F = 1 N (into the paper); conductor perpendicular to B
Maloom karna hai (Required): I = ? aur us ki simt
Hal (Solution):
F = BIL sin 90°
I = F/(BL) = 1 N/(0.5 T × 2 m) = 1 A
Simt F = I L × B se: B daayein (x̂), current neeche se oopar Q se P (ŷ) ho to ŷ × x̂ = −ẑ, yani page ke andar, jaisa diya hai. Is liye current Q se P ki taraf hai.
(Fleming's left-hand rule se check: pehli ungli daayein B ke saath, angootha page ke andar, doosri ungli oopar, Q se P.)
Jawab (Answer): I = 1 A, Q se P ki taraf
